summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_035 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, produces deterministic public-routing decisions for bounded operating assets, degrades headquarters or otherwise inadmissible targets before technical routing, and preserves report-type gating instead of fabricating technical admissibility.

findings: The implementation accepts the declared upstream routing inputs from subject and target definition surfaces, intake observables and classification gating, with the wrapper enforcing a mapping-shaped input contract before delegation.

The adapter emits the contractually expected routing surface: routing readiness, jurisdiction resolution, mandatory, high-priority and optional source lists, evidence-gating outputs, report-type allowance and prohibition outputs, and critical-field summaries.

Executable coverage confirms the documented core behaviors: NYC operating-asset routing, San Francisco headquarters blocking, industrial-facility route promotion in Houston, and city-specific routing behavior for Oakland, Los Angeles and Houston building cases.
The implementation stays within boundary: it selects routing plans and report-surface degradation only; it does not scrape sources, assemble datasets or fabricate downstream technical conclusions.

The output surface preserves structured routing metadata aligned with the technical schema, including jurisdiction_resolution, source_routing_plan, routing_eligibility, critical_field_contract, critical_field_summary, evidence_gating_plan and report_type_switch_recommendation.

Mandatory and high-priority source rows carry stable source descriptors such as source_key, source_name, layer, access_method, authority, priority, limitations and disallowed_as_substitute_for, which is sufficient to drive downstream discovery without lossy remapping.

The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check produced a New York route with routing_ready=true, report_type_allowed=Minimum Evidence Report, missing_critical_fields=0 and a jurisdiction_resolution consistent with the expected NYC regulatory stack.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered the routing contract for high-data building cases, headquarters degradation, industrial process routing and multiple city-specific public-data portal selections. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises the core admissibility, routing-plan and report-gating surfaces described in test_spec.md and failure_modes_spec.md.
test_results.notes: Ran pytest -q on runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_public_data_routing_engine.py with 7 passing tests. Also executed a read-only smoke invocation through artifacts/implementation/codebase/engine.py using the documented NYC example shape and confirmed the wrapper returns the runtime adapter surface without local logic drift.
